scope.label: Outside the boundary
scope.definition: The system or party was likely never in the tested population, so even though the criteria applied, the scoping of the report did not reach it.

design.label: Control design
design.definition: A control existed or could have, and as designed it would not have stopped this step.

operation.label: Control operation
operation.definition: The control was defined and did not work on the day, or did not cover the whole population.

beyond.label: Beyond SOC II
beyond.definition: No criterion would reasonably have prevented this step, and it is included because leaving it out would overstate what SOC II can do.

open.label: Not public
open.definition: Not enough has been disclosed to say how a control would have failed.
